title.rendered: NOTICE OF BUDGET COMMITTEE ORIENTATION MEETING

content.rendered:
A public meeting of the Budget Committee of the Sherwood School District to discuss the role of the Budget Committee and the budget development process for the fiscal year July 1, 2018 to June 30, 2019, will be held in the Community Room, of Edy Ridge Elementary School, 21472 SW Copper Terrace, Sherwood, OR  97140. The meeting will take place on Wednesday, April 25, 2018, at 5:30 p.m.


Please click here for additional information regarding upcoming Budget Committee meetings including, meeting dates, agendas and minutes.
